services.desc: Mont-Tremblant snow tubing park is a fun outdoor activity for the entire family. Sliding down the hill on an inflatable snow tube and let the mechanical lift take you back up to the top! Perfect for an après-ski or evening adventure with the whole family or for groups. Views of St Jovite village.
